firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.permit.how: Whitetail need three things: a Hunting Licence, a Deer Tag and an open season. The licence is never sold: the Ranger Academy issues it when you finish all %2$s courses (press %3$s). A Deer Tag is bought at a ranger counter.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.claim.how: That's a whole hunt, done right. Claim your reward: %s tokens and eight field arrows. Spend tokens at the ranger counters on more tags.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.done.how: You did the whole thing: paperwork, sign, wind, shot, track and harvest. From here, the Handbook and the hunting journal cover every other animal, and the ranger counters sell next season's tags.

firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.title: Hunting rules
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.get.head: Your licence and your tag
firsthunt.frontierhunts.rules.get: The Hunting Licence is never sold. The Ranger Academy issues it when you finish the whole Academy, all %2$s courses (press %1$s for the courses), and a new one every season after that. A Deer Tag is only ever bought, at a ranger counter: an expedition board, contract board, lodge stores, ranger window or camp post.

licence.frontierhunts.page.lic.what: Needed for all hunting. Never sold: the Ranger Academy issues it when you finish every course.
licence.frontierhunts.expedition.relaxed: Relaxed regulations: carry a Hunting Licence (issued by the Ranger Academy when you finish it), a tag for big game and a stamp for game birds, and hunt in season. Buy tags and stamps standing at an expedition board, on the Licence & Tags page of the Hunter's Journal. A first violation is a warning, then small fines.
Get a Hunting Licence: finish the whole Ranger Academy and it issues one.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.how: The Hunting Licence is never sold: finish every Ranger Academy course and the Academy issues it, then a new one every season. Big game also needs a tag and game birds a stamp, bought at an expedition board (Handbook, Journal: Licence & Tags). Under the default Relaxed rules a hunt without one only earns a warning the first time.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.card: Get a Hunting Licence: finish the whole Ranger Academy and it issues one. An unlicensed first deer only earns a warning.
journal.frontierhunts.home.perk_all: Woodsman: ranger's game report. Tracker: head counts in the report. Guide: 10% off at the counter. Master Hunter: 20% off and one more deer tag a season. Legend: free game reports. Journal XP comes from clean, legal, recovered harvests, tracking, contracts and the checklist.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.guide: Guide: 10% off tags, stamps and ranger services.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.legend: Legend: game reports are free, on top of 20% off and the extra deer tag.
